3faf426d0c2fedbdd97fdc2aa6ae43eef323b78d.summary: This is a code repository landing page for a project titled Tor Socket Server Emulator For WannaCry 2.0, tagged malware, ransomware, reversing, server and wannacry. It lists a README, a PHP server file and an include folder, plus a commit history. The page gives no threat analysis, actor attribution, victims, sectors, dates of attacks, indicators or vulnerabilities.

3f3aed9ad668eda74e5140d895f2b5d6b5d11271.summary: A malware-development tutorial by a blogger (cocomelonc) showing a simple Windows keylogger proof-of-concept written in C, which records keystrokes to a local text file. It is an educational how-to article about a programming technique, not a report on threat activity by any actor, campaign or incident. It mentions several named groups and malware families only in passing.
hedges: This is a practical case for educational purposes only.

3f780cfb0f5b50f46b0ab544610e6279810af77c.summary: Intego's blog describes HZ RAT, a macOS remote access Trojan first observed in 2022 targeting Windows PCs and now on Macs. It gives attackers full remote control and is described as mainly used for data collection: installed app lists, WeChat and DingTalk user data, and username-site pairs from Google Password Manager. One known installer is a trojanised OpenVPN Connect. How victims get the installers is not known. The post lists antivirus detection names and C2 IP addresses, most apparently in China; these are not recorded here.
